controlFields.Distribution: DESNZ SRO, DPO/Privacy Lead, ICO (if consulted), CDDO, Security Lead
controlFields.Project Name: UK Smart Meter Data Consumer Mobile App
controlFields.Data Controller: The organisation that determines the purposes and means of processing personal data (DESNZ for this service)
controlFields.Author: Enterprise Architect
controlFields.Vendor HLD Review: Vendor design must implement DPIA mitigations (encryption, access controls, consent management)
controlFields.Vendor DLD Review: Detailed technical controls must match DPIA mitigation requirements
controlFields.Service Assessment (GDS): DPIA demonstrates Point 5 (Make sure everyone can use the service) and data protection compliance
controlFields.Procurement (SOW): DPIA requirements flow into vendor RFP; DPA requirements for all processors
controlFields.Backlog: DPIA conditions (DPO appointment, breach response plan, pen testing) generate backlog items
controlFields.Data Subject: An identified or identifiable natural person whose personal data is being processed
controlFields.Data Processor: An organisation that processes personal data on behalf of the controller (e.g., DCC, cloud hosting provider)
controlFields.Personal Data: Any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person
controlFields.Special Category Data: Sensitive personal data (race, health, biometric, etc.) requiring Article 9 basis
controlFields.Processing: Any operation performed on personal data (collection, storage, use, disclosure, deletion)
controlFields.Profiling: Automated processing to evaluate personal aspects (predict performance, behaviour, preferences)
controlFields.Pseudonymisation: Processing that prevents identification without additional information kept separately
controlFields.Anonymisation: Irreversibly removing identifying information so re-identification is not possible
controlFields.Lawful Basis: Legal ground for processing under GDPR Article 6 (consent, contract, legal obligation, etc.)
controlFields.DPIA: Data Protection Impact Assessment — required for high-risk processing under Article 35
controlFields.ICO: Information Commissioner's Office — UK data protection supervisory authority
controlFields.UK GDPR: UK General Data Protection Regulation (retained EU GDPR post-Brexit)
controlFields.DPA 2018: Data Protection Act 2018 — UK law supplementing UK GDPR
controlFields.DCC: Data Communications Company — smart meter infrastructure operator
controlFields.MPAN: Meter Point Administration Number — unique electricity meter identifier
controlFields.MPRN: Meter Point Reference Number — unique gas meter identifier
controlFields.SEC: Smart Energy Code — industry code governing smart metering
controlFields.DESNZ: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
controlFields.DPA (agreement): Data Processing Agreement — contract between controller and processor
controlFields.SCC: Standard Contractual Clauses — mechanism for international data transfers
